ambient_events: Somebody runs a starter turbine up on the stand for ten seconds, listens to it with their head on one side, and shuts it down.
A cable drum is walked across the floor on its edge and leaned against the wall.
Grit sifts down from the roof plates when a truck pulls into the shed next door.
The tube light over the stand flickers and comes back.
A binder bar is tapped along its length with a spanner, end to end, for the note.
description: A side bay off the shed, walled in salvaged plate. Turbines stand on stands along one wall with their covers off, and coils of steel cable hang on pegs above a bench of spanners. Under a tube light in the middle, a racer is up on blocks: two engines, a binder bar welded between them and a bathtub of a pod lying where its cables have been let out. A chequered strip is painted across the floor at the shed door, and a board on the wall says RACERS and the prices, chalked.
name: The Deadleg racer bay
